updates.content:
Title: We're looking into a potential problem impacting Microsoft Teams

User impact: We're checking for potential impact to your users.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Teams and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Some users may be unable to access or use Microsoft Teams functionality

User impact: Some users may experience issues when accessing or using Microsoft Teams functionality.

Current status: Our investigation has identified elevated service errors affecting multiple Microsoft Teams operations, including messaging and presence functionality. We're analyzing the associated error patterns and service dependencies to isolate the underlying cause and determine appropriate mitigation actions.
 
Scope of impact: Any user accessing Microsoft Teams services hosted in or routed through the Americas regions may be impacted. We’re working to better understand the full scope of impact.
 
Next update by: Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 4:30 PM UTC

Affected users may experience symptoms including, but not limited to:

- Delays or failures when sending chat messages.
- Errors when creating or updating chat conversations.
- Issues retrieving messages or loading conversations.
- Delays or inaccuracies in presence status updates.
- Intermittent failures when using affected Microsoft Teams chat functionality.

This quick update is designed to give the latest information on this issue.

Next update by: Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 4:30 PM UTC

Title: Some users may be unable to access or use Microsoft Teams functionality

- Errors when creating or updating chat conversations.

Additionally, we’ve identified reported and likely impacted scenarios as we narrow the focus of our investigation, which are listed above in the “more info” section of this communication.
 
Scope of impact: Any user accessing Microsoft Teams services hosted in or routed through the Americas regions may be impacted. We’re working to better understand the full scope of impact.

Title: Some users may be unable to access or use Microsoft Teams functionality

Current status: We're seeing further signs of service improvement, with telemetry indicating a reduction in errors and associated customer impact. While some intermittent errors remain, we're continuing to assess additional mitigation measures to further improve service stability. We're closely monitoring affected functionality to validate sustained recovery.

Title: Some users may be unable to access or use Microsoft Teams functionality

User impact: Some users may have experienced issues when accessing or using Microsoft Teams functionality.

More info: Affected users may have experienced symptoms including, but not limited to:
 
- Delays or failures when sending chat messages.
- Errors when creating or updating chat conversations.
- Issues retrieving messages or loading conversations.
- Intermittent failures when using affected Microsoft Teams chat functionality.
 
After further review, we've determined that presence status was not impacted.
 
Final status: Our mitigative actions have successfully restored service health and functionality. Customer impact is now fully resolved.
 
Scope of impact: Any user accessing Microsoft Teams services hosted in or routed through the North and South America regions may have been impacted.
 
Start time: Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 2:45 PM UTC
 
End time: Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 3:53 PM UTC
 
Preliminary root cause: Resource contention within the underlying service infrastructure resulted in elevated resource utilization, which affected the service's ability to process Microsoft Teams messaging requests as expected.
 
Next steps:
-We’re investigating resource utilization balance in the affected service infrastructure to identify improvements to prevent similar issues in the future.

We'll provide a preliminary Post-Incident Report within two business days and a final Post-Incident Report within five business days.
